snippet.title: Forever Love [really old High School project]
snippet.description:
So I was scrummaging through my old files when I found this gem I helped create back in 2006 with my Video Editing class. This is the final project, ripped from the class collective DVD. Juli has the original DV tape, so I don't have access to the best quality, but I thought this would be a nice video to share and maybe catch the attention of the staff who helped work on it!

We really did film in the snow, those poor kids. Looking back, it was amazing how they put up with what Juli and I made them go through the entire semester! I usually ended up taking over ALL the story ideas and then Juli would be the mean boss/cameraman/director. Haha, good times.

Credits:
Storyboard, Music and Art Direction: Salahare (aka Czarina aka ME), never seen
Director and Editor: Juli, never seen, contributed props
Actors: Scott (as Knight), Wiedow (as Maiden/Princess), Bryan (as Evil Mage, aka "the evil one"), and Aimee (Fairy in Homecoming Dress)

If you were in my group for this project, hope this brings back memories!

snippet.title: Speed Drawing 1/2 Prince - Swallowtail Butterfly
snippet.description:
Here's my first ever screencapture video of what I do when I draw, complete with program crash at the end. The final picture can be seen in all it's glory here:
http://salahare.deviantart.com/art/Swallowtail-Butterfly-136195675

As you can see, it looks really different than in the video. That's because about 4 hours into the drawing, GIMP crashed. Foolish me, the last time I had saved was right after placing the butterfly images in... *cry*

Hope you guys enjoy!

Songs are:
Japanese Music Box by George Winston
Swallowtail Butterfly by Ashin? (the chinese one, not japanese)
